rules: UI copy uses periods or commas. Do not chain clauses with em dashes.
Max one em dash (—) in all visible UI copy combined. Zero is better.
Status and success lines: short sentence. Example: "Link sent. Check inbox." not "Link sent — check inbox."
Hero subcopy: one idea per sentence. No "Build X — ship Y — scale Z" rhythm.
CTAs are verbs or verb phrases without em dashes: "Send link", not "Send link — free".
Reserve em dashes for rare `<title>` separators only if the product voice demands it.
slopPatterns: Multiple em dashes in body copy (AI brochure rhythm)
Subtitle chain: three clauses separated by em dashes
CTA or status line with em dash punchline
goodExamples: We'll send one link. Then you choose a new password.
badExamples: Build faster — ship smarter — scale infinitely
Ink rises as credentials align — the gate is typographic, not decorative.
